candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (ReadTimeout), and order's own call to payment also times out; payment authorization latency (~2s) propagates up through order to the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side spans are not directly observed; the ~2s payment authorization span is inferred from the gateway's payment client span. Root cause within payment (e.g. its own dependency) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by transport ReadTimeouts on gateway->order and order->payment, with payment authorization spans taking ~2s while inventory/redis are fast. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded to downstream latency in the order/payment path.
